skill.name: context-degradation
skill.description: Diagnose context degradation in AI agents, including lost-in-middle failures, poisoning, distraction, confusion, clash, and attention issues.
skill.summary: Diagnose and mitigate context failures in long-running AI agent conversations.
skill.author: muratcankoylan

content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose critical facts, mix tasks, or amplify bad context. This skill helps diagnose the pattern and choose targeted mitigation.
actual_capabilities: Explains five context degradation patterns and their symptoms.
Recommends placement strategies for critical information in long contexts.
Describes recovery steps for poisoned or contradictory context.
Includes Python utilities for simulated attention and poisoning checks.
Maps mitigation choices to write, select, compress, and isolate strategies.
limitations: Attention scores are simulated and are not model-internal measurements.
Token counts use simple whitespace splitting, not provider tokenizers.
The script does not connect to model providers or monitoring systems.
Teams must benchmark thresholds against their own workloads.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Find whether an agent is failing from lost facts, irrelevant context, poisoning, confusion, or clash.

use_cases.title: Review Prompt Context Layouts
use_cases.description: Place critical instructions and evidence where models are more likely to use them.

use_cases.title: Design Degradation Monitoring
use_cases.description: Create practical checks for context growth, quality drops, and compaction triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Simple Failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis for one failing conversation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this agent failure for context degradation. Symptoms: [symptoms]. Context length: [length]. Recent changes: [changes]. Recommend the most likely pattern and first fix.

prompt_templates.title: Review Context Placement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a long prompt or conversation layout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this context layout for lost-in-middle risk. Identify critical information, weak placement, and changes that move key facts to stronger positions.

prompt_templates.title: Recover From Poisoning
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recovery after bad retrieved facts or tool errors entered context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this session for context poisoning. Find the likely contamination point, list verified information to preserve, and propose a clean restart plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Monitoring
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design for a team running context-heavy agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context degradation monitoring plan for our agent workflow. Include metrics, alert thresholds, compaction triggers, and tests for confusion and clash.

output_examples.input: An agent ignores a key requirement that appears halfway through a 60,000 token session.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: likely lost-in-middle. Move the requirement to the opening task block and final checklist, then retest with the same workload.

output_examples.input: A retrieval system returns two current-looking documents with different API endpoints.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: context clash. Mark the conflict, choose source precedence, and exclude outdated versions before the documents enter context.

output_examples.input: A model keeps repeating a wrong tool result after the user corrects it.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: likely context poisoning. Restart before the bad result, reload verified facts, and track the rejected claim separately.

best_practices: Benchmark degradation thresholds with the same tasks and models used in production.
Place critical goals, constraints, and conclusions near the beginning or end of context.
Filter, summarize, or isolate context before quality drops become visible.
anti_patterns: Adding corrections on top of poisoned context instead of removing the bad content.
Assuming a larger context window always improves output quality.
Loading every retrieved document before checking relevance and source conflicts.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps identify why long AI sessions lose quality and suggests focused mitigation steps.

faq.question: Does it measure real model attention?
faq.answer: No. The included script simulates attention patterns for demonstration and design review.

faq.question: Can it prevent context poisoning?
faq.answer: It describes prevention and recovery practices, but teams must validate inputs in their own systems.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance applies to long-context work across these assistant environments.

faq.question: When should I use another skill?
faq.answer: Use related skills when you need compression tactics, token optimization, filesystem context, or evaluation setup.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The documented guidance and Python demo run locally without external service calls.
